card.title: Retroactive Permission
card.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you support a small improvement to the front garden?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Something with a pond. And no tree.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's finish agreeing before the stump grinder leaves.

mechanism: A seeks agreement to a garden change while delaying acknowledgment that removal has already happened.
confusable: Unlike requesting future permission, the dialogue must expose completed action beneath the approval question.
comparison: D04-a uses a present stump-grinder deadline to reveal prior action; D04-b offers chairs to win assent after issuing invitations.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
